verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is New Relic Agent Control with Terraform, documented for declaratively managing fleets of agents at scale. That covers fleet-level agent configuration, not general bulk operations across entities, alerts or dashboards. The CLI's tag management and cross-account entity search are not documented as bulk actions. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operations across entities, alerts or dashboards; bulk actions via NerdGraph, CLI or MCP; any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
